title: OFF! De-Centering Feminist Architectural History
summary: This edited volume gives voice to women architects from the “OFF-Stage”, those working in the shadows of the canon or at its margins. Through 27 short biographies and a series of scholarly essays, it presents global, intersectional, and queer-feminist perspectives on architecture and space. Bringing together authors from a range of regions and career stages, the volume advances a critical feminist historiography attuned to multiplicity, contestation, and the ongoing reconfiguration of architectural history.
